Document the boundary for alternate historical fixtures.

fix(test): wait for owner outcome lock writes

concurrent owner publication cannot fail test setup. Retain all cleanup
and durable failure assertions.

head_commit.message:
test(module): give public source-warning startup enough time

The success case budgets five seconds for descriptor compilation and probes.
On the loaded CI runner that work exceeds the budget and the json case fails
before the fake AppHost can report healthy.
